flashcard_questions.q: Descriptions of the ways in which energy can be stored — there are eight energy stores you need to know.
The principle that energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred from one store to another or converted from one form to another.
The energy store associated with a moving object — the faster it moves and the greater its mass, the more kinetic energy it has.

flashcard_questions.a: The energy store associated with the temperature of an object — the hotter it is, the more energy is in its thermal store.
The energy stored in the bonds between atoms in fuels, food, and batteries — released during chemical reactions.
